notes: Five EE drop-day fixes folded into one release. Cloudflare Waiting Room support — the bot now sits through EE's drop-time queue page instead of bailing on it. Keyword-mode preorder fix — Include Existing OFF tasks no longer miss preorder-launched products like Funko drops. Connection-timeout retry — single proxy hiccup mid-checkout no longer kills the task. Auto-retry on cart-empty — bot re-ATCs up to 5 times when inventory race clears the cart between ATC and checkout, no more spam-restarting tasks. Ghost-cart parser fix — every EE rejection was previously misread as 'success' because 'Not Added To Cart' contains 'Added To Cart' as a substring. Parser now reads EE's wrapped-XML response correctly.
